items.label: Occupational interviewing

student_evidence.text: What is important in your routine? Who provides support?

items.rubric_anchor: 0: no relevant learner evidence; 1: identifies an activity; 2: elicits a stated priority and context; 3: checks priorities, support/preferences and missing information without assuming them.

case_fact.text: I want to choose my own clothes and put on a comfortable shirt before breakfast. That matters more to me than doing every household task alone.

recommendation.title: Bilal: planning a journey with his child
recommendation.reason: Revisit occupational interviewing, the lowest provisional coverage dimension. An educator may choose a different focus; keyword coverage is not a diagnosis of skill.

report.limitations: Original unvalidated formative rubric coverage; synthetic examples do not validate learner grading.

agent.limitations: Rule mode is a bounded selective workflow. Model-directed planning is separately configured and not claimed in rule mode.
